data.name: ShowQr
data.comment: Tick box on the Labels page. The QR code on a label opens its plant or cutting when scanned.

data.name: LayoutStickers
data.comment: A choice of layout on the Sheet tab of the Labels page, next to Pots and Stakes. Sheets of sticker paper.

data.name: LayoutStickersNoteA4
data.value: 21 stickers per sheet, 63.5 × 38.1 mm, the size most office shops sell.
data.comment: Note under the layout choice on the Labels page, with A4 paper.

data.name: LayoutStickersNoteLetter
data.value: 30 stickers per sheet, 66.7 × 25.4 mm, the most common address-label sheet.
data.comment: Note under the layout choice on the Labels page, with Letter paper.

data.name: PrintActualSize
data.value: Print at actual size (100 %), not fit to page.
data.comment: Note by the Print button on the Labels page when sticker sheets are chosen, so the labels land on the stickers.

data.name: StartAt
data.comment: Label of a number box on the Labels page. The first sheet leaves the stickers before this number empty, so a half-used sheet can be used.

data.name: StartsAt
data.comment: Under the start number on the Labels page. {0} is the sticker number, {1} its row and {2} its column on the sheet.

data.name: LinkPageTitle
data.comment: Title of the browser tab on the page a label's QR code opens.

data.name: LinkBadTitle
data.comment: Heading on the page a label's QR code opens, when the link isn't one Stikling knows.

data.name: LinkBadText
data.value: The link on it isn't one Stikling knows.

data.name: LinkGoToStikling
data.comment: Button to the front page of the app.

data.name: LinkDeletedTitle
data.comment: Heading on the page a label's QR code opens, when its plant or cutting was deleted on this device.

data.name: LinkDeletedText
data.value: The plant or cutting this label is for was deleted on this device.

data.name: LinkWaitingTitle
data.comment: Heading on the page a label's QR code opens, while the first sync after signing in brings the collection to this device.

data.name: LinkWaitingText
data.value: It opens as soon as your collection has arrived on this device.

data.name: LinkWaitingProgress
data.comment: Spoken name of the progress bar on the same page.

data.name: LinkSignedOutTitle
data.comment: Heading on the page a label's QR code opens, when the plant isn't on this device and nobody is signed in.

data.name: LinkSignedOutText
data.value: The plant it belongs to isn't on this device. If it's yours, sign in and it opens once your plants have arrived.

data.name: LinkAppHint
data.value: Keep Stikling as an app on your phone? Open it there and use Scan a label.
data.comment: Scan a label is the name of a button in the app that reads a QR code with the camera.

data.name: LinkAbout
data.value: Stikling keeps track of plants and their cuttings, for free and on your own phone.

data.name: LinkNotMineTitle
data.comment: Heading on the page a label's QR code opens, when someone is signed in and their collection is up to date but doesn't have the plant.

data.name: LinkNotMineText
data.value: This label is for a plant that isn't in the collection on this device. It may be from someone else's collection.
